# UrbanMop

> > UrbanMop is a comprehensive home services platform in UAE offering on-demand cleaning, maintenance, wellness, and specialized services for residential and commercial properties.

UrbanMop operates across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah, providing a wide range of home services through a mobile app and website. The platform connects customers with professional service providers for everything from deep cleaning and AC maintenance to plumbing, electrical work, wellness services, and pet grooming.
